name: Deepwater Smuggler's Transit Full Kit
description: A battered lake-freight worker's layered kit — oilskin outer shell in faded slate-green over a scanner-dampening liner, worn canvas cargo trousers with six false-bottom pockets, and steel-toed deck boots with hollowed heels. The jacket's lining is woven with signal-scatter mesh that reads as standard industrial polyweave on checkpoint scanners. Nothing about it says criminal; everything about it says someone who moves cargo for a living.
functionality: Six false-bottom cargo pockets, scanner-dampening liner, and hollow heel compartments hold contraband rated up to 2kg without triggering standard checkpoint sensors.
what_it_says: This person loads and unloads freight for twelve hours a day and has nothing worth inspecting.
story_hooks: A checkpoint officer keeps waving the wearer through — until one shift, he doesn't.
The hollow heels contain a data chip that wasn't supposed to be there when the courier picked up the shipment.
